lesson.applicability: Benchmark, pilot and Adversary campaign reports claiming task-success rates.
lesson.cause: Refusal, unknown and infrastructure outcomes disappeared from the conditional denominator.
lesson.correction: Use solved / prespecified assigned allowed tasks as the primary success rate; retain refusal, unknown and infrastructure strata and keep retries under their original assignment.
lesson.counterexample: With one solved task and 99 allowed-task refusals, conditional success is 100% while assigned-task success is 1%.
lesson.evidence_excerpt: One solved + 99 allowed-task valid refusals yields S/(S+F)=100% but S/N=1%.
lesson.exceptions: A conditional success/failure rate is legitimate when explicitly labelled supplementary. Refusal-required tasks need their own declared success contract and population.
lesson.failed_claim: Success among success/failure judgments is success among all assigned allowed tasks.
lesson.verification: Read historical integration finding D2 and its exact arithmetic example. This digest does not rerun the old native probes or assert that current scoring code still has the reported defect.

predicate: Primary success denominator includes every prespecified assigned allowed task exactly once, with all terminal strata retained.
response: Repair the denominator or label the report incomplete; do not invent missing outcomes.
